_doc: Main menu map catalogue (docs/MENU_LOBBY.md 'Adding a map'): the file stem is the map id. level: what game_host loads (data/levels/<level>.json or a procedural map). season (spring | summer | autumn | winter, assets/world/seasons.json), time_of_day 0..24 and weather (start preset, empty = a pick of the season's presets) are the lobby's defaults and the menu background's look.
name: Dev Room
description: The engine's test hall and yards: horde yard, weather yard, vehicle yard, sighting lane, flesh range and the post-processing corner.
